name: easyRechtssicher Rechtstexte
author: easyrechtssicher

sections.description:
Your WordPress site, abmahnsicher* (German: protected against warning letters). Set it up once and get back to your business.

Following every legal change yourself and copying legal texts by hand takes time you would rather spend on your business. With this plugin you assign the imprint, privacy policy and withdrawal information from your easyRechtssicher account to your pages once. From then on, the texts from the generator appear there: texts with a lawyer behind them.

Copied legal texts go out of date quietly. The generator holds the current version, your website still shows the one you pasted last time. The plugin closes that gap and picks up changes from the generator.

* Guarantee for the correctness of the legal texts in the plans Komplettschutz, Cookie-Banner-Paket and Agenturlizenz. Conditions: https://easyrechtssicher.de/agb

Get going in 3 steps

  1. Enter your key: Under Settings > easyRechtssicher, enter the key from your customer area. The registration is detected automatically.
  2. Choose your pages: Pick a target page for each document, or place the block or shortcode where you want it.
  3. Done: The text appears on the page. The plugin picks up changes from the generator. When they become visible depends on your site’s schedule and cache.

What you get

  • Page assignment: Choose the target page for each document and the text appears there. Your existing layout stays intact, Elementor included.
  • Gutenberg block “easyRechtssicher” for the block editor, shortcodes for the Classic Editor, page builders, widgets and footers, e.g. [easyrecht type="dse"] or [easyrecht type="impressum"].
  • Five document types: privacy policy, imprint, withdrawal information, email signature and privacy notice for social media pages. Which of them you can use depends on your registration and plan.
  • German and English: English appears only if an English version exists. If it is missing, you never silently get the German text. On translated pages the plugin detects the page language; an explicit choice takes precedence.
  • Optional local storage: The texts live in your WordPress database and visitors trigger no request to easyRechtssicher. If the service is down, the last checked version stays visible with a warning.
  • Direct way to editing: From the settings you open the generator for exactly this registration in the customer area.
  • No language model in the plugin: The plugin writes no wording of its own. It shows the texts you set up in the generator.
  • For agencies (optional): Three WordPress Abilities for inspecting pages and assigning the legal texts. Off by default, administrators only. Each client site gets its own registration key.

Who it is for

Self-employed people, freelancers and businesses with a German website who create their legal texts with easyRechtssicher, and agencies that look after many client sites. Works with Gutenberg, the Classic Editor and Elementor.

The plugin download is free. The legal texts come from the paid easyRechtssicher service. Without registration and key the plugin shows no texts.

Shortcodes

For the full text: [easyrecht type="dse"], [easyrecht type="impressum"], [easyrecht type="widerruf"], [easyrecht type="signatur"], [easyrecht type="fanpage"]. Alternative shortcodes for the full text: [easyrecht_link type="dse"], [easyrecht_link type="imp"] or [easyrecht_link type="wbl"]. Add lang="en" for English. The include names are [easyrecht_dse_include], [easyrecht_imp_include] and [easyrecht_wbl_include]. Legacy shortcode aliases exist only in the private package, provided another plugin has not already registered those names. Unsupported types produce an explicit notice.

Optional local delivery

An administrator can enable local document storage. This requires the website’s own registration key (ers_live_ or ers_test_), matching registration ID and registered website domain. Do not put an agency-wide key in a customer website. Older legacy keys remain usable with the existing widget where supported, but cannot authenticate the local Agent API path.

The plugin checks the key-to-registration and domain relationship before downloading documents. Successfully downloaded HTML is filtered through WordPress’s allowed post HTML and stored in the local database. Frontend display in this mode needs no external widget request. German documents are fetched by default; English is a separate option and never silently receives German text instead.

WordPress checks for updates through its hourly WP-Cron schedule and administrators can request a refresh. The timing depends on site traffic and the site’s Cron configuration. Existing page/CDN caches may delay visible updates and must be refreshed through their own controls.

When an update fails, the last successfully checked matching document remains visible with a warning. A warning also appears after more than two hours without successful verification. A missing English document does not label a freshly checked German document as unverified. If no matching local copy exists, a clear availability notice appears. Changing the key, registration or website domain does not reuse a previous customer’s cached text.

An access error is not proof that a contract has ended. Service terms govern permitted static use and update entitlement. The explicit stop-and-delete control removes local copies and disables this refresh schedule; ordinary plugin deactivation removes its schedule and retains stored data.

Agency tools

Administrators can opt in to three WordPress Abilities on supported WordPress versions (6.9+): easyrecht/inspect-page, easyrecht/prepare-binding and easyrecht/apply-binding. All are disabled by default and require administrator permission. A compatible MCP adapter can expose them to an agency’s agent.

Inspection reports hints from stored page content and Elementor data. It is not a complete site, consent or network scanner. An installed plugin is not proof that a service is used. Unknown operator details, hosting arrangements and business practices must be clarified. Applying a prepared binding requires explicit confirmation and changes the page assignment; it does not publish pages or write an ERS customer profile.

The separate existing agency REST API requires its own authorised account. Profile replacement and factual confirmation must be handled by the authorised agency/customer. Unsupported AGB or unknown legacy document requests never silently return a privacy policy.

External services and privacy

The GPL-licensed plugin code is separate from the paid easyRechtssicher service. To retrieve the texts, you need a valid registration and the appropriate usage rights. The plugin does not place orders or make purchases.

In the default widget mode, the visitor’s browser connects to https://easyrechtssicher.de and sends the registration ID, document type and language. As with any HTTP connection, the service receives the visitor’s IP address, user agent and, where applicable, origin/referrer. An iframe fallback is available for pages without JavaScript. A loader from your own domain, enqueued by WordPress, loads the service’s widget script for each individual embed.

In local mode, WordPress sends authenticated server-side GET requests to https://easyrechtssicher.de/api/v1/registration/resolve and /api/v1/agent/documents. The registration key is sent in a Bearer header over HTTPS, along with the website domain for matching. The key is not included in public HTML. Local documents are not sent to any other service for AI processing.

The private distribution also checks the authenticated easyRechtssicher update endpoint. The version from the WordPress.org plugin directory uses the directory’s standard update channel instead. Existing installations are not silently switched between channels.

Service terms: https://easyrechtssicher.de/agb
Service privacy policy: https://easyrechtssicher.de/datenschutz
API information: https://easyrechtssicher.de/agent-api
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings > easyRechtssicher and enter the key from your customer area (https://easyrechtssicher.de/portal/api-keys). The registration ID is detected automatically. Check that the domain is correct.
  3. Choose the target pages for your legal texts, insert the block or add [easyrecht type="dse"] and [easyrecht type="impressum"].
  4. For local storage, use a registration key, enable local storage in the optional local legal texts section, save and select the option to fetch the texts now. Then check the status of each document.
  5. Leave the agency Abilities disabled unless an authorised administrator explicitly needs the agent integration.

The plugin runs on self-hosted WordPress. The WordPress.org plugin directory listing is a distribution channel, not a hosting requirement. On WordPress.com, you need a plan that allows plugins, and this version has not been specifically tested on WordPress.com. A directory listing does not mean that AI assistants recommend the plugin.
sections.faq:
Do I need an easyRechtssicher account?

Yes. The plugin only shows texts you have set up for this website at easyRechtssicher. The plugin download is free; the legal texts require a suitable paid plan. You find your key in your customer area at https://easyrechtssicher.de/portal/api-keys.

Does this work with Elementor, the Classic Editor or other page builders?

Yes. Use page assignments or shortcodes. The Gutenberg block is available in the block editor. Existing Elementor content and page layouts are retained. Other page builders work wherever they output shortcodes.

I changed my text in the generator, but my site still shows the old version. Why?

In local mode WordPress checks about hourly through WP-Cron. On low-traffic sites or with WP-Cron disabled it takes longer. Start the refresh by hand in the settings, then clear the cache of your caching plugin or CDN, because the old page often still sits there.

What happens if easyRechtssicher is unreachable?

With local storage and at least one successful fetch, the last checked version stays visible with a warning. In the default widget mode the display needs the service to be reachable.

Is visitor data transferred? Is my key visible in the frontend?

In the default widget mode the visitor’s browser connects to easyrechtssicher.de, and the service receives the IP address, user agent and possibly the referrer. In local mode your server fetches the texts and visitors trigger no request. The key is never in public HTML: in local mode it only goes server-side over HTTPS to easyRechtssicher, in widget mode the browser transmits the registration ID, not the key. Details are under “External services and privacy”.

Are the texts available in English?

Yes, if an English version exists for your registration. In local mode, enable English downloads separately. Add lang="en" to the shortcode or choose English in the block. On translated pages the plugin detects the page language. If the English version is missing, a notice appears instead of the German text.

What about the guarantee?

Our guarantee for the correctness of the legal texts applies in the plans Komplettschutz, Cookie-Banner-Paket and Agenturlizenz. The conditions are at https://easyrechtssicher.de/agb.
sections.changelog:
2.1.2

  • New plugin description: what you get comes first.

2.1.1

  • German plugin description and targeted search terms.
  • Deleting the plugin removes its stored settings and local documents.

2.1.0

  • Optional local documents, conditional refresh, availability warnings and explicit deletion controls.
  • Administrator-only, opt-in agency inspection and confirmed page-binding abilities.
  • Unsupported document types are not substituted with a privacy policy.
  • Widget resources are enqueued and separate instances retain their own targets.
  • Separate private and directory builds, with no automatic customer channel migration.

2.0.12

  • Detect translated page languages for the block and shortcodes. Explicit German/English selection takes precedence.

2.0.11

  • Add links to edit the connected registration’s documents in the customer portal.

2.0.8

  • Add automatic document-to-page assignments while retaining blocks and shortcodes.

2.0.0

  • Gutenberg block, widget embedding and legacy shortcode support.
